Text: Agent Sandboxing and Safe Execution

Agents that can run code or call tools need strong isolation. Sandboxing limits what the agent can access and do, protecting the host system and sensitive data from mistakes or malicious behavior.

This is becoming essential for safe production agents.

As a dev, I now run agents inside proper sandboxes by default.

Agent Sandboxing Cheatsheet:
- Isolate agent execution from the main system
- Restrict file system, network, and tool access
- Use lightweight VMs or secure containers
- Apply multiple layers of isolation
- Log and monitor everything that happens inside the sandbox
Pro tip: Never give an agent unrestricted access to the host environment
